g1.label: 1. When is Book Character Day?
g1.why: The recording says Book Character Day is next Wednesday.

g2.label: 2. Who judges the competition?
g2.why: The recording says Miss Carter will be judging the costume competition.

g3.label: 3. What does the winner receive?
g3.why: The recording says the winner receives a ten pound book token.

g4.label: 4. Alternative to dressing up?
g4.why: The recording says students who don't want to dress up can write a short paragraph instead.

g5.label: 5. When are written entries due?
g5.why: The recording says writing entries must be handed in by Tuesday afternoon.

g6.label: 6. Who is Marcus dressing as?
g6.why: The recording says Marcus is going as Percy Jackson.

g7.label: 7. Why Katniss for Ellie?
g7.why: The recording says Marcus suggests Katniss because Ellie already has a bow from archery club.

g8.label: 8. What does Ellie decide?
g8.why: The recording says Ellie decides to do both — dress up and write her paragraph.

g1.label: 1. Leo — brave, takes charge
g1.why: The text says the Leader always puts the team first and makes brave decisions under pressure.

g2.label: 2. Ava — builds and invents
g2.why: The text says the Inventor solves problems with clever gadgets.

g3.label: 3. Noah — found his place
g3.why: The text says the Outsider doesn't fit in at first but has a hidden talent.

g4.label: 4. Sofia — values loyalty
g4.why: The text says the Best Friend is always there to support the hero.

g5.label: 5. Costumes only from books
g5.why: The text says costumes must be based on a character from a book, film, or comic — not only books.

g6.label: 6. Competition at lunchtime
g6.why: The text confirms the costume competition takes place during lunchtime.

g7.label: 7. Entries read aloud
g7.why: The text says writing entries are displayed on the library wall, not read aloud.

g8.label: 8. Cost to enter
g8.why: The text says entry to both competitions is completely free.
